semiconductor_relevance: High — Aquafine provides specialized ultrapure water treatment solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Aquafine Corporation specializes in UV water treatment systems that ensure high-quality ultrapure water for the semiconductor industry. Their solutions are designed to reduce total organic carbon (TOC), destroy chlorine and chloramines, and provide microbial disinfection, which are essential for maintaining the integrity of semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Ultrapure water treatment systems for TOC reduction

regional_presence.Taiwan: Aquafine partners with local companies to provide customized solutions and reliable technical support.
